Mode: Shape of the time-displacement map. hgradient: left-to-right. vgradient: top-to-bottom. radial: centre outward. noise: animated noise. in2: use the in2 TOP's luminance.
Frames: Depth of the effect in frames: how far back in time the map can reach. Limited to Buffersize minus 2.
Direction: forward: map value sets how old each pixel is. reverse: inverts the map so old and new swap.
Speed: Scroll speed of the map in cycles per second, back and forth seamlessly. 0 = static; negative scrolls the other way.
Smooth: Blend between adjacent stored frames for smooth results instead of stepped bands.
Active: Record new frames into the buffer. Off freezes the stored history.
Reset: Pulse: fill the whole buffer with the current frame, clearing the history.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Buffersize: Number of frames stored in the ring buffer (8-128). Sets the maximum Frames; changing it reallocates memory.
Bufferscale: Size of stored frames relative to Resolution (0.125-1). Lower saves memory but looks softer.
Look: Recolours only the built-in test source shown while in1 is unconnected. original: coloured; mono: black, bone-white and grey. A connected in1 is not recoloured.
Accent: Amount (0-1) of red accent added to the built-in test source when Look is mono or original. Only affects the demo source; 0 = none.
